headline: Manage every employee's record, access, and lifecycle from one connected system.
subheadline: From onboarding to confirmation and growth, keep employee data structured and scoped to the right people.

pointLibrary.title: Central Employee Database
pointLibrary.description: Maintain a single, centralized profile for every employee containing employment details, documents, and history.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Creates a single source of truth and eliminates scattered employee records.

pointLibrary.title: Configurable Company Structure
pointLibrary.description: Set up branches, departments, designations, and employment types before onboarding begins.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Keeps the organization structured and reporting accurate from day one.

pointLibrary.title: Bulk Employee Import
pointLibrary.description: Import employee records in bulk using a standard template or existing HR data.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Speeds up rollout for large or already-established workforces.

pointLibrary.title: Role & Department-Scoped Access
pointLibrary.description: Grant system access based on department, designation, and responsibilities, so HR and managers only see relevant employees.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Improves data security and keeps management scoped to the right teams.

pointLibrary.title: Automated Probation Tracking
pointLibrary.description: Probation timelines are tracked automatically, with alerts before confirmation dates.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Ensures no employee's confirmation date is missed.

pointLibrary.title: One-Click Confirmation
pointLibrary.description: Move employees from probation to permanent status in a single action.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Reduces administrative steps in the employee lifecycle.

pointLibrary.title: Employment Increment Workflow
pointLibrary.description: Raise, review, and approve salary or role increments through one structured, logged process.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Brings transparency and accountability to compensation changes.

pointLibrary.title: Document Management
pointLibrary.description: Store and manage employee documents alongside each profile.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Eliminates paper-based recordkeeping and lost documents.

headline: Track employee attendance accurately with real-time visibility and automated payroll integration.
subheadline: Digitize attendance tracking across your organization while reducing manual work and payroll errors.

pointLibrary.title: One-Tap Check-In & Check-Out
pointLibrary.description: Employees can record attendance instantly using the mobile app with a simple tap.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Reduces manual attendance tracking and improves employee convenience.

pointLibrary.title: GPS-Enabled Attendance
pointLibrary.description: Attendance can be recorded only from approved locations using GPS verification.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Prevents attendance fraud and ensures location-based accountability.

pointLibrary.title: Real-Time Attendance Monitoring
pointLibrary.description: Attendance updates instantly across the organization, giving HR immediate visibility.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Enables faster decision making and better workforce monitoring.

pointLibrary.title: Automatic Payroll Integration
pointLibrary.description: Attendance data is automatically incorporated into payroll calculations.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Reduces payroll errors and eliminates repetitive manual calculations.

pointLibrary.title: Comprehensive Attendance Reports
pointLibrary.description: Generate detailed attendance reports for employees, departments, or branches.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Provides valuable insights for HR analysis and management reporting.

pointLibrary.title: Late Arrival Tracking
pointLibrary.description: Automatically identify late arrivals and calculate attendance statistics.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Encourages punctuality and supports company attendance policies.

pointLibrary.title: Multi-Branch Attendance
pointLibrary.description: Monitor attendance across multiple offices or branches from a single dashboard.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Ideal for organizations operating from multiple locations.

pointLibrary.title: Live Attendance Dashboard
pointLibrary.description: View who's present, absent, or on leave through an intuitive dashboard.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Provides management with an instant overview of workforce availability.

headline: Digitize leave requests and approvals with complete visibility for employees and HR.
subheadline: Flexible leave policies with automated tracking, self-service requests, and centralized administration.

pointLibrary.title: Centralized Leave Management
pointLibrary.description: Manage all leave policies, requests, and approvals from one place.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Removes fragmented, manual leave tracking across teams.

pointLibrary.title: Automated Leave Balance Tracking
pointLibrary.description: Automatically monitor leave balances, accruals, and usage.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Gives employees and HR an accurate, up-to-date leave picture.

pointLibrary.title: Bulk Leave Approval
pointLibrary.description: Review and approve multiple leave requests at once.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Saves HR time during high-volume approval periods.

pointLibrary.title: Split Leave Across Categories
pointLibrary.description: A single approved leave period can be split across multiple leave types, such as casual and another category.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Gives HR flexibility to apply leave policy accurately.

pointLibrary.title: Integrated Holiday Calendar
pointLibrary.description: Built-in public holidays are factored into leave planning automatically.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Prevents scheduling conflicts with official holidays.

pointLibrary.title: Employee Self-Service Leave Application
pointLibrary.description: Employees can submit leave requests in a few simple steps from their phone.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Reduces paperwork and speeds up the request process.

pointLibrary.title: Real-Time Leave Balance & History
pointLibrary.description: Employees can view their available leave and full request history instantly.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Increases transparency and reduces HR queries about balances.

headline: Automate payroll with attendance, leave, and deductions fully integrated.
subheadline: One connected pipeline from attendance and leave data to accurate, audit-ready payroll.

pointLibrary.title: Automated Late Deduction
pointLibrary.description: Late penalties are calculated automatically from attendance records.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Removes manual penalty calculations and reduces disputes.

pointLibrary.title: Policy-Based Leave Deduction
pointLibrary.description: Deductions are applied automatically when paid leave is unavailable, based on company policy.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Ensures payroll reflects leave policy consistently.

pointLibrary.title: Absence Deduction
pointLibrary.description: Unapproved absences are automatically converted into accurate payroll adjustments.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Keeps payroll aligned with actual attendance.

pointLibrary.title: Flexible Deduction Rules
pointLibrary.description: Deduct from salary or leave balance based on configurable company policy.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Adapts to different organizational compensation rules.

pointLibrary.title: Flexible Pay Cycles
pointLibrary.description: Run payroll on monthly, bi-weekly, fixed-date, or hourly cycles.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Supports diverse workforce pay structures.

pointLibrary.title: Flexible Pay Structure
pointLibrary.description: Calculate compensation by pay grade or individual salary.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Accommodates varied compensation models across the organization.

pointLibrary.title: Bonus Management
pointLibrary.description: Add overtime, attendance, and custom bonuses in one place.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Consolidates all pay additions into a single payroll run.

pointLibrary.title: Automated Payroll Generation
pointLibrary.description: Generate final payroll directly from attendance, leave, and pay rules.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Eliminates manual handoffs between attendance sheets and salary runs.

headline: Create flexible schedules and assign employees with ease across branches.
subheadline: Build shift patterns once and roll them out across the organization in a few clicks.

pointLibrary.title: Flexible Shift Creation
pointLibrary.description: Define shift timings and combine them into reusable weekly or rotating patterns.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Saves time building schedules from scratch each period.

pointLibrary.title: Branch & Department Customization
pointLibrary.description: Configure different schedules for departments, branches, or employee groups.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Supports organizations with varied operating hours across locations.

pointLibrary.title: Bulk & Individual Assignment
pointLibrary.description: Assign one employee or hundreds to a schedule in a few clicks.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Makes large-scale scheduling fast and manageable.

pointLibrary.title: Drag-and-Drop Rescheduling
pointLibrary.description: View the full week at a glance and reassign anyone, anytime.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Gives managers a fast, visual way to handle schedule changes.

headline: Organize employees into departments and business units that mirror your organization.
subheadline: Bring structure, scoped access, and clearer reporting to every department.

pointLibrary.title: Department Management
pointLibrary.description: Organize employees into departments and business units that mirror the real organizational structure.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Creates a clear, structured view of the company.

pointLibrary.title: Department Hierarchy
pointLibrary.description: Maintain reporting hierarchy across departments and business units.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Clarifies reporting lines for management and HR.

pointLibrary.title: Department-Level Permissions
pointLibrary.description: Scope access and management rights to specific departments.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Keeps managers focused on their own teams and improves data security.

pointLibrary.title: Department-Based Reporting
pointLibrary.description: Generate reports and insights segmented by department.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Improves visibility into performance and metrics at a team level.

headline: Maintain company positions and reporting hierarchy consistently across the organization.
subheadline: Standardize job titles and keep role-based access aligned with real responsibilities.

pointLibrary.title: Designation Management
pointLibrary.description: Maintain a standardized list of company positions across the organization.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Keeps job titles consistent and easy to manage.

pointLibrary.title: Reporting Hierarchy by Designation
pointLibrary.description: Define reporting relationships based on designation levels.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Removes confusion around who reports to whom.

pointLibrary.title: Role Mapping
pointLibrary.description: Map designations to system roles and permissions.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Ensures access rights stay aligned with job responsibilities.

headline: Track probation periods and notify HR automatically before completion.
subheadline: Never miss a confirmation date with automated tracking and alerts.

pointLibrary.title: Automated Probation Tracking
pointLibrary.description: Every probation timeline is monitored automatically from the day an employee joins.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Ensures no probation deadline is missed.

pointLibrary.title: Confirmation Alerts
pointLibrary.description: Automatic reminders are sent to HR before a probation period ends.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Gives HR time to review performance before the confirmation date.

pointLibrary.title: One-Click Confirmation
pointLibrary.description: Move an employee from probation to permanent status in a single action.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Simplifies a process that is otherwise manual and easy to overlook.

headline: Manage hiring requests and recruitment approvals through one auditable workflow.
subheadline: Every requisition follows a clear, trackable path from request to final decision.

pointLibrary.title: Employee Requisition in a Few Clicks
pointLibrary.description: Managers raise a request for a new hire directly in the system, routed straight to HR for approval.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Removes informal, untracked hiring requests.

pointLibrary.title: Built-In Approval Workflow
pointLibrary.description: Every requisition moves through a clear, auditable chain of approvals.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Adds accountability and transparency to the hiring process.

pointLibrary.title: Vacancy Tracking
pointLibrary.description: Track open positions and their approval status in one place.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Gives HR and management visibility into the hiring pipeline.

pointLibrary.title: Complete Request History
pointLibrary.description: Keep a full, searchable record of every requisition, from request to final decision.
pointLibrary.businessBenefit: Provides an audit trail for hiring decisions.

subheadline: Bring transparency and accountability to every compensation change.

pointLibrary.title: Digitized Increment Requests
pointLibrary.description: Raise, review, and approve salary or role increments through one structured workflow.

pointLibrary.title: Increment Approval Tracking
pointLibrary.description: Track the status of every increment request from submission to final decision.

pointLibrary.title: Increment History
pointLibrary.description: Maintain a full history of salary and role changes for each employee.

pointLibrary.title: Real-Time Attendance & Leave Overview
pointLibrary.description: A live view of who's in, who's on leave, and workforce trends across every branch.
